note: The one width-2 polyomino whose rectangle-tiling status Dahlke's Gun Theorem leaves unresolved. Tulleken lists it as Problem 52.

rectifiable.note: Dahlke reports testing rectangles up to width 85 without finding a tiling or a proof of untilability. The fe70 project has since ruled out, by exact search, every rectangle with a side of at most 127 (and sides 129 and 130); see fe70.org for the live search frontier.
